Where simtte builds and caches compiled models

Source: R/parallel.R
simtte_model_cache.Rd

Resolves and returns the directory sim_tte_ode and simtte_prepare_model pass as mrgsolve's own soloc argument (where a model's compiled shared object is built and stored) – simtte itself never sets options() on a user's behalf, for mrgsolve's own options or this package's simtte.cache_dir; this function only ever reads getOption("simtte.cache_dir") and appends a version-qualified subdirectory before returning it.

Usage

simtte_model_cache()

Value

Character scalar: an existing, writable directory path.

Details

Default (simtte.cache_dir unset): a directory under tempdir(), i.e. session-scoped and automatically cleaned up – CRAN-safe (nothing is ever written outside a session temp directory unless you opt in below) and the right choice for any single script or session, including a local parallel cluster (every worker of a local cluster shares the parent's filesystem, so a model built once under the parent's own cache directory is directly reachable by every worker's loadso call – see ?sim_tte_ode "Parallel simulation").

Persistent cache: set options(simtte.cache_dir = tools::R_user_dir("simtte", "cache")) (the standard, CRAN-compliant location for a package's own cache data – simtte_model_cache never chooses this for you) to keep a compiled model's shared object across R restarts, avoiding a repeat compile in a later session. This matters most for a slow-to-compile tte_model-converted model reused across many scripts, or a genuinely distributed cluster whose worker nodes do not share the parent's filesystem (where every node needs to be pointed, itself, at the same shared, network- visible directory).

Version-key caveat: whichever directory simtte.cache_dir resolves to, a subdirectory keyed by the current R version, this simtte version, and the installed mrgsolve version is always appended before it is returned or created. This is deliberate, not incidental: mrgsolve's own build-cache key is content/mtime based, not version-aware (verified: its own ?mread documentation states plainly that soloc is "a directory location where the model shared object is built and stored", with no mention of invalidating it across an R or package upgrade) – a persistent cache surviving an R version change or a simtte/mrgsolve upgrade risks reusing a compiled .so built against a different, ABI-incompatible R/package version. The version key makes that class of staleness unreachable by construction rather than relying on mrgsolve's own file-level staleness detection to catch it (which can be defeated by two builds landing in the same filesystem-timestamp second – see tte_model's own name documentation). The default, tempdir()-based location needs no such protection on its own (a session cannot upgrade R or a package mid-run), but the key is applied unconditionally anyway, so there is exactly one code path to reason about, not two.

See also

simtte_prepare_model, which builds into this directory (as mrgsolve's soloc). simtte_model_cache_clear, to remove what accumulates here. sim_tte_ode and tte_model also build into it; see "Parallel simulation" in ?sim_tte_ode.

Examples

simtte_model_cache()
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpRbowND/simtte-model-cache/R4.6.2-simtte2.0.0.9000-mrgsolve2.0.1"
